page.content:
Kieuemo was a Guard captain Fish Speaker who reported to the God-Emperor Leto that Hwi Noree had survived the Face Dancer attack on the city of Onn in 13728 AG. She was promoted to the rank of sub-bashar on the spot.

page.overview:
Who is Kieuemo?

Kieuemo was a Guard captain Fish Speaker who reported to the God-Emperor Leto that Hwi Noree had survived the Face Dancer attack on the city of Onn in 13728 AG. She was promoted to the rank of sub-bashar on the spot.

She had a heavy build like Nayla but her body was more round compared to that of Nayla.
